content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script for the FUNWAVE-TVD sediment_rip case showing eta, suspended sediment concentration and morphological depth change. User input section (L4-L13) sets fdir='../work/output/' (L8). Loads dep.out (L17), n,m from size (L18), dx=1, dy=2 (L19-L20), meshgrid (L25); figure 9x4 inches (L29). Snapshot range fixed nstart=nend=5 (L35-L36; interactive input commented L32-L33; legacy comment L37). Per snapshot (L40-L114): zero-padded fnum (L45), loads umean_, vmean_, eta_, mask_, concentration C_, and evolving bathymetry dep_<fnum> (L48-L53); computes bed change depp=dep1-dep (L54); masks eta/dep/u/v where mask<1 (L57-L60). Three panels with ax=[0 249 0 199] (L62): (1) eta pcolor caxis [-0.6 1.2], jet, south colorbar labeled eta (m) (L65-L77); (2) log10(ch) pcolor caxis [-1 1] with colorbar 'log10(C) (g/l)' (L82-L85) and black quiver of u,v subsampled every sx=sy=4 points scaled s=10 (L91-L94); (3) contourf of depp with colorbar 'depth change (m)' and caxis [-0.05 0.05] (L100-L108). pause(0.1) (L113); nothing saved.
entities: h_bar colorbar handle L70, L84, L104

equations.ref: morphological bed change = evolving depth minus initial depth

unresolved: depp is computed at L54 before dep is NaN-masked at L58, so panel 3 shows bed change everywhere including masked dry cells; the ordering differs from the eta masking and may be intentional or an oversight
concentration ch is plotted unmasked (no ch(mask<1)=NaN line, unlike the vessel scripts which mask ch); log10(ch) yields -Inf for zero concentration
concentration unit label g/l (L85) with caxis [-1 1] implies 0.1-10 g/l displayed; conversion assumptions are not stated in the file
dep masked in-place (L58) accumulates across frames when a multi-frame range is used
